To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the formation of professional teacher competence is possible only in the innovative educational environment.

the formation of innovative education in the development of the professional competence of future teacher through the formation of the environment of the future teacher is the basis for the development of the teacher professional competencies in the context of the market relations.

the innovative educational environment, which is the basis for the formation of the future teachers' professional competence, is the most important factor in the development of professional competence of a teacher, as well as in the formation of the teacher’s professional competence in the context of modern market economy.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of the formation of innovative educational environment in higher education, which is aimed at the formation of professional competences of future teachers.

the following tasks: to analyze the concept of innovative education and the formation of professional competencies of future teachers in the innovative educational environment; to identify and analyze the main directions of the formation of innovative education in Ukraine; to determine the place and role of the innovative educational space in the formation of the professional competence of future teacher in the context of innovative education.

the development of professional competence of the teacher as a key factor in the development of innovative education in the context of the market economy, the development of the innovative environment as the basis for the development of professional teacher competence in the context of innovative education.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the innovative educational environment is an important factor that contributes to the development of professional competence of teachers, which, in turn, contributes to the development and improvement of the educational system.

the formation of professional competencies of future teachers is impossible without the formation of the innovative environment in the educational process, and the formation of the environment in the educational environment is impossible without the use of innovative methods and technologies of education.

the development of innovative education in the development of professional competence of teachers is the formation of a new type of professional competence of a future teacher, which is the formation of the ability to use the knowledge, skills, abilities and skills of a future teacher in the educational environment, the formation of the necessary qualities that will allow the teacher to be a professional in the context of the market economy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the innovative educational environment contributes to the formation of the professional competence of the future teacher, and the formation of professional competencies in the future teacher is a complex and long process that includes the formation of the necessary knowledge, skills and abilities, and the ability to use this knowledge in the educational environment.
the teacher should have a wide range of professional skills that will allow him to be in demand in the market of educational services.

the teacher's professional competence is formed in the innovative educational environment, which is characterized by the presence of the following qualities: the ability to work in a team, the ability to communicate in a foreign language, the ability to use modern information and communication technologies in the educational process, the ability to work creatively, the ability to solve non-standard problems, the ability to self-organization and self-control.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the development of innovative education in the training of future teachers is a necessary condition for the formation of a professional competence of a teacher.
innovative educational environment is the most effective tool for the formation of teacher professional competence.

the innovative educational environment should be based on the principles of humanization, openness, creativity, and self-realization, which will allow students to acquire the necessary knowledge, skills, and qualities to become successful professionals in the field of education.
